name: tvloop
description: Run tvloop's hardware suite against a Roku on this host's network: doctor, the contract tests, and a JUnit replay of its flows. With params.androidtv, Fire TV and Android TV devices over adb replay the flows too.

steps.description: What to run, in order. Default doctor, install, hardware, replay -- tvloop's own nightly, plus sideloading the checkout's channel (the Roku's one dev slot may hold something else), minus the spike, which sideloads ten times and is slow. A failed doctor or install stops the rest.

flows.description: Flow names or paths for replay. Default: every flow in the checkout's tests/flows.

dir.description: The tvloop checkout, built. Default FLEET_TVLOOP_DIR, then ~/tvloop.

package.description: The app's Android application id, e.g. com.taylab.dozehound.debug. tvloop launches it and filters its logs by it.

flows.description: Flows to replay on the TVs. Default: the same as flows above.

androidtv.description: Opt in to Fire TV / Android TV: adb targets that declare leanback run too. Only doctor and replay run on them -- install, spike and hardware are the Roku adapter's -- and they need no Roku password.
